verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's privacy docs offer an EU Data Residency Program, so customers can choose to process and store personal data in Europe rather than the default location. That directly delivers the core of choosing a storage region. Missing for 10: documentation of how a project's region is selected or migrated, any regions beyond the EU, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Mixpanel provides you with the option to process and store your customers' personal data in Europe via our EU Data Residency Program.
